name: hud_stack_wave_list_numbers_at_hard
description: The waves to come give each creep's health and armour at the level played and at its own wave, with waves stacked on the road (0.8.0's playtest fix, the numbers in the list, joined with M8's levels and stacked waves; a playtester on m8 found them missing). In High Water at Hard alone the rows carry Hard's numbers, not Normal's (hud_wave_list_health_and_armour's): creeps 10% more health (wave 4's Thornback 154 hp, not 140), a boss 50% more and its armour 1 more (the Bristlesow 1688 hp and armour 7, the Crest 3938 hp and armour 5), from the very sums the spawns take (SimWaves.health_c and armor_c). With wave 2 called during wave 1 both are on the road: the list starts at wave 1, marks both now and gives each its own wave's health (wave 1's Gourdlings 27 hp, wave 2's 33), and the newest Gourdling of each wave on the road has the health its row gave.

steps.assert: Game.level() == 'hard' and int(Game.sim.rules['hp_pm']) == 1100 and int(Game.sim.rules['boss_hp_pm']) == 1500 and int(Game.sim.rules['boss_armor_c']) == 100
steps.msg: Hard's numbers laid over High Water

steps.assert: node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[3] == '4: armored | gourdling ×8 · 47 hp, thornback ×4 · 154 hp · armour 4'
steps.msg: wave 4 at Hard: 10% more health, the same armour

steps.assert: node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[5] == '6: armored | thornback ×3 · 198 hp · armour 4, bristlesow boss · 1688 hp · armour 7 (armored)'
steps.msg: the Bristlesow at Hard: half again its health and one more armour
wave 2 called during wave 1: both on the road

steps.assert: node('WaveRows').get_child(0).name == 'WaveRow1' and node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[0] == '1: swarm | gourdling ×10 · 27 hp' and node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[1] == '2: swarm | gourdling ×18 · 33 hp'
steps.msg: the list starts at the older wave on the road, each wave with its own creeps' health at Hard
both marked now, the next not
a Gourdling of each wave on the road has the health its row gave
